items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: I worked with Benny in so many different bands.

ctx.x: Tell me. When you came down to the Savoy, Johnny Hodges told you to go over to Small's Paradise and listen to Benny Carter...

No. He said, 'Go over to Small's Paradise and listen to the greatest saxophone player in the world. His name is Benny.' So Harry and I, we went there. And we walked up to the bandstand... The bandstand was low, right
